Implements AG Grid runtime, APIs, CSV export, and a React data grid view.

# Purpose
AG Grid core runtime code defines the services, controllers, model objects, and helper functions that manage grid state and grid UI behavior. It covers column creation and movement, sizing, grouping, pivoting, selection, filtering, sorting, focus, drag and drop, editing, pagination, scrolling, and event dispatch. Internal classes and services such as `columnModel`, `columnFactory`, `visibleColsService`, `columnSizeService`, `columnMoveService`, `pivotResultColsService`, `userComponentFactory`, `menuService`, `navigationService`, `mouseEventService`, `scrollVisibleService`, and `animationFrameService` work together to keep the rendered grid in sync with user input and data changes. The file also exposes public API functions and module descriptors, such as `getFilterInstance`, `setFilterModel`, `getQuickFilter`, `resetQuickFilter`, `startEditingCell`, `stopEditing`, `refreshCells`, `ensureColumnVisible`, `getColumnState`, `paginationGoToPage`, `getState`, `getDataAsCsv`, and `exportDataAsCsv`, so other code can use grid features through a stable interface.
